issues.description: The problem statement's example for toString() (line(s) 36-39) formats numeric attributes with surrounding single quotes (e.g., numberOfInscribedStudents='600'), which visually suggests those fields are Strings. However, the UML and task text clearly define these attributes as ints (lines 63-68). This discrepancy may confuse students about the expected data types of the attributes.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the example to avoid implying numeric attributes are Strings. Remove the quotes around numeric values in the toString() example (e.g., numberOfInscribedStudents=600) or add a note that the quotes are only part of the string formatting example and that the attributes themselves are of type int as shown in the UML.
